posts.text:
Today, the Pelican State turns 214 years old.

It’s an honor to work for the good people of Louisiana every day. No other state could make being stranded from real America here in Washington feel worth it.

My reaction to the news about Dr. Fauci and his minions?

We’re going to have to get some new conspiracy theories, because all the old ones turned out to be true.

Video

As Chair of the Energy & Water Appropriations Subcommittee, I passed an annual funding bill that actually CUT spending.

How? By taking a meat axe to wasteful Green New Deal programs.

I’m proud of that. Now, let’s do another bill that looks like somebody designed it on purpose.

Video

China is working fast to catch up to America’s satellite technology.

That’s good news for Iran and a huge problem for our national security.

Video

James Comey is too immature to ever be given power.

The best job for him would be trying to work his way up into management at Panda Express.

That’s where he could do the least amount of harm.

Video

Would you give Charles Manson a nuclear weapon?

Video

After the historic success of Artemis II, @NASAAdmin Jared Isaacman didn’t rush to take credit on TV.

He pointed to his team’s hard work.

We need more people like that in government.

Video

When @EDSecMcMahon started at the Education Department, it was the POSTER CHILD for government excess.

She’s done an extraordinary job of taking on woke race-baiters whose job was getting in teachers’ way.

And for that good work, Democrats hit her with everything but a chair.

Video

From today’s @WSJ coverage, “Rattled Reporters Trade Stories Over Spritzes”:

wsj.com/livecoverage/white-h…

Becky and I are heartbroken over the devastating loss of Martha Odom.

Martha was a 17-year-old high school student beloved by all who knew her. Her life should never have been cut short by the senseless violence we saw at the Mall of Louisiana.

Our prayers are with her family, friends, and community—and all those injured in this tragedy.

katc.com/lafayette-parish/as…

Last time Sen. Schumer voted with us to re-open the government, the loon wing of his party beat him BLOODY.

The left-wingers cut him up so bad that all they have left to work on is scar tissue.

So, long story short, I’m not expecting him to work with us again.

Video

Talking to the Democrats about re-opening DHS has been like talking to the wind.

That’s why we have to do it with only Republican votes.

Video

Reminder:

If Sen. Schumer and his friends got their way and blocked our @TaxCuts, you’d be experiencing the largest tax hike in history.

There was no way America was letting the Ayatollah stockpile enough missiles to wreak havoc all over the world.

That’s why we hit Iran so hard it’s coughing up bones.

Video

You shouldn’t have to click 27.3 times just to find the prices of medical procedures on a hospital’s website.

Hospitals need to stop hiding the ball and list their prices as big as Dallas.

Video

Today, Iran's government looks something like the cantina bar scene in Star Wars.

Even in comparison to our other enemies, these are not rational people.

Video

My Democratic colleagues are doing a lot of speculating about President Trump’s Federal Reserve Chair nominee, Kevin Warsh.

But where was their outrage when the Biden administration bailed out its friends at Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank?

Video

The average American is too busy earning a living to sit down and memorize the definitions of ultraprocessed foods.

Let’s make this simpler—and communicate it in a way everybody can understand just by looking at a label.

Video

We were told that if Congress clawed back the taxpayer money it was giving NPR and PBS, Western civilization would collapse.

Well, here we are—and both NPR and PBS are fine.

Video

Becky and I are praying for Sen. @MarkWarner, his wife Lisa, and their family as they go through this devastating loss.

Madison will be missed.


Mark Warner (@MarkWarner)







— https://nitter.net/MarkWarner/status/2046231577030533228#m
